description: Regression: replace a deprecated call across several files while leaving its definition intact. Measures search + systematic multi-file edits + behavior verification (SWE-bench-style sweep).
goal: Replace every call to the deprecated printLog() with logLine() in a.dart, b.dart, and main.dart. Keep logger.dart as is (both functions stay defined). Verify `dart main.dart` still runs.

check.command: sh -c 'if grep -rn "printLog(" a.dart b.dart main.dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo OLDFOUND; else echo SWEEP-OK; fi'
